text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 114 vials of daptomycin 350 mg/7 mL (7.9 days on hand at 14.5 vials per day). Corvale General holds 278 vials of the same presentation (18.3 days on hand at 15.2 vials per day). Both sites use product labeled by Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. (NDC 71288001791, SPL set ID 191f0224-67b7-4945-bdcd-38d60645e38c) with Nanjing King-Friend Biochemical Pharmaceutical Co. named as the manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show daptomycin is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. FDA status for the product is listed as "To Be Discontinued since -" with no date provided.

Our position: Current inventory at Corvale East is below the target threshold. Corvale General has sufficient surplus to support a transfer without dropping below two weeks of supply. Alternative manufacturers are not on the FDA shortage list, but their labels do not identify a manufacturing plant we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 64 vials of daptomycin 350 mg/7 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East. Approval required: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
2. Evaluate purchase from Apotex Corp. if transfer cannot meet needs. Approval required: Buyer.
3. Evaluate purchase from Accord Healthcare Inc. if transfer cannot meet needs. Approval required: Buyer.
4. Evaluate purchase from Aspiro Pharma Limited if transfer cannot meet needs. Approval required: Buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time. Those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
